sourceIntensity.scope: No I/RGB input is read or rewritten; no measured per-source intensity equality or native FW draw claim

limits: Native SourceT-only existing-renderer probe: no FW/VTF/native material draw or per-source I measurement, no scene/canvas/physical update.
Warmup is a separate explicit call of at most4 draws. Pair is explicit retained-token ABBA of at most8 more draws; no automatic larger dispatch.
All borrowed density/ordered-ray data copied before first await; session holds at most one owned input and two warmed fields for5minutes, then disposes.
Only the valid output prefix is read, at most2 readPixels rectangles perprepare,16bytes/source; unused nonempty output capacity is not a valid read.

All valid rows compare bitwise with the frozen baseline; at most16 deterministic rows use all packets in independent physical/packed-double oracles. These samples do not prove a universal1e-5 GPU error bound.
Own per-render timer queries exclude CPU packing/readback/oracle. A synchronous prepare can issue both passes before timer results are available; >25ms/incomplete/disjoint stops the next prepare.
Two measured samples per mode are exploratory isolated map/reduce observations, not whole-scene60fps or evolving-simulation admission. Constructor caps and pair gate remain unchanged.
